all-hands-bot: Recording is up at https://redwood.ai/all-hands/174900 — thanks for coming! :clap:
maya: that sax riff in the finale should be illegal 😂
raul: i swear the saxophonist was in the breakroom next to my desk :saxophone: loud and proud
sophie: can someone make a 10s GIF of the sax + confetti combo pls :eyes:
kevin: i'll try — after i finish my smores. yes, smores at my desk. marshmallow casualty count: 2 :fire:

jess: proof: posted a shaky phone video in #random — someone stabilize it and make it cinematic :movie_camera:

maya: 🍫 (smores forever)
kevin: 🍦 (but i brought extra graham crackers if anyone changes their mind)
devon: both. compromise is a campfire sundae :camping:
jess: GIF request bump — i'll make a tiny edit and drop in a thread later :sparkles:
all-hands-bot: Reminder: if you want your moment clipped for the highlights reel, DM @sophie-ops with timestamp and short caption :memo:

maya: not me but 10/10 production value :tada:
sophie: can we add 'mic-bounce' to the official all-hands playbook? :book:

jess: also, huge kudos to product for the roadmap clarity — applause in person when we meet IRL :clap::clap:
devon: +1. and if anyone wants the raw audio clip of the sax solo, i have it (beauty and chaos)
raul: signing off to grill another marshmallow. goodnight all-hands heroes :crescent_moon:
